user.title: Flame Boss / EGG Genius
user.description: Enter the controller's IP address and its PIN (in the Flame Boss / EGG Genius app under Controllers > Security > Show PIN, or on the controller's settings screen). The controller must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

discovery_confirm.description: Found a Flame Boss / EGG Genius controller at {host}. Enter its PIN to connect (app: Controllers > Security > Show PIN).

reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the PIN. Enter the current PIN.

reconfigure.description: Change the controller's IP address or PIN.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller. Check the IP address and that it is powered on and on Wi-Fi.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
